notes.title: Ramen Shop Simulator Beta!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who tried the demo and gave us feedback![/p][p]As a tiny team of just three people working with a very limited budget, it’s impossible for us to test every possible combination of things ourselves — so we truly appreciate all the bug reports and gameplay feedback we’ve received. We’re working as hard as we can to deliver the best game possible![/p][p]After working on this game for quite some time without showing much, we realised it’s far better to share the process and let the community take part in development. That’s why we’ve decided to open up a [b]beta branch[/b]![/p][p]This is your chance to get an early preview of upcoming features, systems, and content before they go live in the main version — and to help us make the game even better along the way. [b]Keep in mind: the beta will likely be full of bugs, half-finished features, and other oddities[/b] — that’s exactly why we need your help testing it!

[b]What You Get by Joining the Beta Branch[/b][/p][list][*][p]Early access to brand-new features and updates[/p][/*][*][p]A sneak peek at what’s coming next[/p][/*][*][p]The chance to directly influence the game with your feedback[/p][/*][*][p]A shiny spot in our hearts ❤️[b] [/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]How We’ll Work Together[/b][/p][p]We’ve set up a brand-new [b]#beta-feedback[/b] channel on our Discord where you can:[/p][list][*][p]Report bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Share your thoughts on new features[/p][/*][*][p]Chat with us and other testers about what’s working well (and what’s not)[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be updating the beta branch regularly with new features and improvements, so there will always be something to test.

If you’re ready to jump in and help us break (and then fix!) the game, head over to our [url="https://discord.gg/u62CgrjNxp"]Discord[/url][b] [/b]for instructions on how to join the beta. [/p][p]Thanks so much for your support! ❤️[/p][p]— [b]The Sannin Team[/b] (Daniel, Johan & Petrus)
[/p]

notes.title: Demo 2 - Store update!
notes.notes:
It’s here: our first content update! We welcome the first (of many) stores to Ramen Shop Simulator.

This store is a mail order one in the shape of a fax machine, you’ll be able to order food, decorations and more from it!

All food etc you order will be delivered immediately outside your restaurant! For now, we've waived the delivery fee.
Decorations will appear magically in your decoration storage!

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New: In-game store! 
[*] New: Right-click a decoration in the decoration storage to sell it[/list]
[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stealing customers
[list]
[*]  We think we’ve gotten it this time, and the customer should no longer try and take your bowls home (even though we understand them)
[*] We’ve added more bowls to prevent soft locking from too much theft
[/list]
[*] Standing lantern no longer falls over
[/list]


Thank you to every one of our players! <3 // The Sannin Team

notes.title: Demo Patch 3
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
We’ve received more feedback—both positive and constructive—than we ever dreamed of. Thank you so much to everyone in our amazing community for your support!

In this smaller update, our focus is on bugs reported in our Discord (link here), improved on in-game info, and most importantly, boosted performance! In order to make Ramen Shop Simulator playable and enjoyable for as many players as possible, while maintaining our visual quality.

Please keep sharing your feedback and helping us make Ramen Shop Simulator the best it can be!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made several under-the-hood tweaks and lowered the default quality of some post effects.
[*] Achieved overall performance gains.
[*] In our internal testing, we saw a 30–60% increase in average FPS.
[*] On lower-spec systems (like the Steam Deck), we now see a stable 40+ FPS.
[*] Added more quality presets and updated the previous ones. Please try them out!
[/list]
[h3]Info Clarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added strikethrough on the order slip when a customer received their item.
[*] Updated the text on the Kenbaiki to state that if there are 0 food recipes on the menu, the restaurant will close.
[*] Added a notification that the restaurant will close if there is no food on the menu.
[*] Improved the text under the crosshair so it updates more reliably when looking at different items, especially while holding another item. This is definitely still a work in progress!
[/list]
[h3]Creation Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cosmetic decorations sometimes had incorrect rotation.
[*] Fixed an issue where decorations sometimes rotated upside down in preview.
[*] Fixed an issue where customized decorations could end up with incorrect rotation.
[*] Ensured customers no longer try to sit on a chair you’re customizing.
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where beer disappeared when poured.
[*] Fixed an issue where chashu sometimes fell through the frying pan.
[*] Fixed an issue where, if a UI screen was open when the day ended, the window did not close.
[/list]

//The Sannin Team

notes.title: Demo Patch 1
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer notes:[/h2]

Thanks to everyone playing the demo and to the people reporting issues and reaching out with great feedback! We have done an initial update based on the feedback and issues reported by you in the community. 

[b]ありがとうございました ![/b]

[i]Special thank you to: catnugget, Outei(おうてい), DauntedFrame647, fei CHANNEL, Catherine, SilentSimulatorGamer, frichards, skyquid, Cynthia & Dr. Dre[/i]

[h2]Full change log below:[/h2]
[h3]Menu and UI[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The menu sometimes disappeared from the ticket machine (kenbaiki), preventing players from selecting or adding menu items.
[*] After quitting to the main menu with a ramen on the order menu, the item remained invisibly present, blocking further actions.
[*] After closing the restaurant (by taking down the Noren) and reopening, no new customers spawned.
[*] In the tutorial, after cooking Sapporo Ramen, the ticket machine only displayed “Clear” and no other options, preventing progress. 
[*] Switching to maximized window mode made it impossible to change the window mode setting again. 
[*] The menu was not displayed on the ticket machine after restarting the game.
[/olist]
[h3]Order and Serving[/h3]
[olist]
[*]We’ve significantly upped the amount of food you get! 
[*] Customer orders on the screen did not match the actual orders or tickets, and sometimes included items not on the menu. 
[*] Customers who ordered beer did not accept it when served. 
[*] Customers could accept multiple beers, resulting in several glasses stacking on their table.
[*] When multiple orders of the same ramen were prepared, the game incorrectly stated that stacked bowls could not be served, even when only one bowl was present, which prevented serving any food.
[*] The “can’t serve stack” or “can’t stack bowls” error was triggered when customers had ordered beer.
[/olist]
[h3]Object Placement and Interaction[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Bowls glitched when placed on the counter, making them difficult to position correctly without dropping them on the floor.
[*] Customers left their bowls on the table instead of returning them to the counter as intended.
[*] Stacking noodle boxes was unreliable, with boxes getting stuck.
[/olist]

Again, thank you to everyone who's played the demo and/or wishlisted the game! 
//The Sannin Team
